from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's contract liability data extracted from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/securities code of the company")
    contract_liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '合同负债' (contract liabilities) amount from the balance sheet")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    source_line_description: str | None = Field(description="Description of where this value appears, e.g. '合并资产负债表流动负债'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
